packageRules.description: Track ISC's kea-dhcp4/kea-dhcp6 (cloudsmith) and bump each Dockerfile's ARG VERSION. Both components track the same Kea release, so Renovate groups them into one PR by default. Restrict to STABLE releases only: Kea ships stable on EVEN minor series (3.0, 3.2, 3.4, ...) and development snapshots on ODD minors (3.1, 3.3), which must never reach the fleet. The even-minor regex excludes odd-minor dev tags.

Auto-merge non-major updates by default (thin build repo; images publish only on a SUCCESSFUL build and the fleet adopts via a reviewed adarigod Renovate PR). Kea minor and Alpine bumps are carved out below.
Auto-merge ALL GitHub Actions bumps including majors. CI-only, low-risk, and the main source of PR churn on this build repo — keep them fully hands-off. A break is caught by the publish build.

Gel with Kea's versioning strategy. Kea's EVEN-minor numbers are distinct STABLE TRAINS (3.2, 3.4, 3.6, ...). A 'minor' bump like 3.2 -> 3.4 is a NEW STABLE FEATURE RELEASE, not a patch: it can change config syntax, hook library names, or require migration. So Kea minors get a REVIEW PR (this overrides the non-major auto-merge above). Only PATCH bumps within a train (e.g. 3.2.0 -> 3.2.1, bugfix/security) auto-merge.

The Alpine base image is coupled to Kea's packaging: the Dockerfiles pin `FROM alpine:<v>` to the Alpine release ISC builds Kea packages for (see the in-Dockerfile note). Bumping Alpine ahead of Kea-package availability breaks the apk install, so Alpine bumps get a REVIEW PR rather than auto-merging.
